name: Ingrid Lindgren
action: Ingrid looks up from her tablet, softens her expression, and says, "Yes, we can bake cookies later this afternoon. I have Mr. Eriksson coming in half an hour, so let me finish this first, and then we’ll do it."
reason: Her initial impulse was to soften and protect the moment with her mother, even while staying aware of the contractor’s deadline. Reflection softened that impulse rather than reversing it: Ingrid now treats the request as a rarer, more meaningful opening for closeness, while also recognizing that Mr. Eriksson is reliable, expects directness, and the suite 7 meeting is already organized. Because her revised tendency was to give reassurance without immediately rescheduling the contractor, she answers warmly and preserves the baking plan for later instead of abandoning the work appointment. That fits her generally composed, precise style and her habit of balancing caregiving with tightly managed hotel duties, while still respecting the emotional weight of her mother’s request.
